title: fix(plugin-auth): store sys_user.locale in its BCP-47 case (zh-cn → zh-CN) on every write path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Fixes #29895

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:用户的语言偏好 `sys_user.locale` 每次写入都按 BCP-47 大小写存(`zh-cn`、`ZH-CN` 存成 `zh-CN`),覆盖数据接口(单条与批量)、管理员导入用户、身份源登录同步三条写入路径;归一用的就是 #29833 给翻译语言做归一的 `LocaleSchema`,没有另写一份。
- 为什么改:列只校验标签形状,`zh-cn` 被原样存下,而控制台按精确匹配挑界面语言,于是这个用户看到英文界面且没有任何报错。
- 风险与回滚:只改大小写,不新增拒绝也不新增接受:`zh_CN` 仍答 400,空值仍是清空;已存的错大小写旧行不迁移,下次写这一列时才归一。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sys-user-locale-case.ts`(钩子与归一),`auth-plugin.ts` 的注册处(优先级 5,在身份写守卫之前),`idp-locale-claim.ts` 的 `resolveIdpLocale`(记录与列同一拼写)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sys-user-locale-case.test.ts`,预期全部通过;真实路由见 dogfood `user-locale-case-fold.dogfood.test.ts`(6 个用例)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **New `sys-user-locale-case.ts` (plugin-auth).** `registerUserLocaleCaseFold` registers `beforeInsert` / `beforeUpdate` hooks on `sys_user` at priority 5, for every context (`isSystem` included). It folds `data.locale` through `canonicalUserLocale`, which is `LocaleSchema.safeParse(value)` from `@objectstack/spec/system`: the parse's output on success, the value as sent otherwise. `canonicalLocaleCase` itself is package-internal in spec by design (its docblock: an exported fold would invite a second fold in a consumer), so the parse is the reuse, and no second fold exists.
- **Registered in `auth-plugin.ts`** at `kernel:ready`, beside `registerMemberRoleCanonicalization` (the same write-path canonicalisation shape and priority slot, ahead of the ADR-0092 identity write guard at 10).
- **`resolveIdpLocale` (idp-locale-claim.ts)** now answers the supported locale in the same case. Without that, a supported list spelled off-case (`zh-cn`) would get the column folded to `zh-CN` while the `idp-locale:` record kept `zh-cn`, and the next sign-in would read the IdP's own value as a local choice (`decideIdpLocaleWrite` compares stored with recorded). With the stock locales this changes nothing (`zh-cn` → `zh-CN` was already the answer).
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, with the two declaration lines.
- ⛔ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` are not touched.

### Write paths measured (origin/main `c618e890`)

| Path | Context | Reaches the column through |
|---|---|---|
| `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/:id`, and the bulk form (`apiMethods: ['get','list','update','bulk']`) | user | engine `update` → identity write guard whitelist (`SYS_USER_PROFILE_EDIT_FIELDS` has `locale`) |
| Admin user import (`admin-import-users.ts:750`, `SYS_USER_IMPORT_UPDATE_FIELDS` ⊇ `locale`) | system | engine `update` |
| IdP locale claim (`idp-locale-claim.ts` `IdpLocaleSync.apply`) | system | engine `update` |
| better-auth's own adapter | none | never: `locale` is not on its user model (`identity-write-guard.ts` `SESSION_SNAPSHOT_MIRRORED_FIELDS` note) |

All of them are ObjectQL writes, so the one hook pair covers them. Generic data import on `sys_user` is not open (`import` is not in `apiMethods`). The format rule runs after the before-hooks (engine `validateRecord` follows `triggerHooks('beforeUpdate')`), and the fold is case only, so the rule's verdict on any value is unchanged. `sys-user-locale-case.test.ts` pins that for every case in its table.

## Tests

- `sys-user-locale-case.test.ts` (new, plugin-auth). The fold table: `zh-cn`, `ZH-CN` → `zh-CN`, `EN` → `en`, `ZH-HANS-cn` → `zh-Hans-CN`, `xx-yy` → `xx-YY`; `zh_CN`, `Chinese`, `zh CN`, a trailing space, `''` and non-strings come back as sent. The fold composed with the real `SysUser` rules through `evaluateValidationRules`: refused after exactly when refused before, and `zh_CN` still `VALIDATION_FAILED` on `locale` / `invalid_format`. The hooks: `sys_user` only, priority 5, fold in place on insert and update, for user, system and no context; canonical, refused and cleared values untouched; no key invented; the shared predicate-update payload folded.
- `idp-locale-claim.test.ts`: one new case, an off-case supported list answers the canonical tag.
- `user-locale-case-fold.dogfood.test.ts` (new, the real door on a booted showcase). A signed-up member's own-row `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/:id`: `zh-cn` and `ZH-CN` → 200, stored `zh-CN`; `GET /auth/me/localization` serves `zh-CN`; `zh-CN` stored unchanged (control); `zh_CN` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, stored value unchanged; a system-context `update` with `JA-jp` stores `ja-JP`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rows stored before this.** Not migrated, per the order. Such a row reads back verbatim: `storedSignedInUserLocale` (plugin-hono-server `current-user-endpoints.ts`) trims it and checks the column's shape rule only, so `/auth/me/localization` still serves `zh-cn` and the console still renders English for that user. That lasts until the column is written again, and the next write is folded.
- **The console's exact-match pick (`domain:ui`, not touched).** Once stored values are canonical it matters for two populations only: rows stored before this release, and canonical tags that are not spelled exactly like a console locale (`zh`, `zh-Hans-CN`, `en-GB`). The server's own matcher (`resolveLocale`: exact → case → base language → variant) would answer those, and the console does not.
- **Out of scope, reported for the seat to file (fold only, no refusal):** the same door stores a shape-valid tag no platform locale serves (`xx-YY`, now stored `xx-YY`) and `''` with 200, as the card notes. Refusing either would narrow the door.
- Serial constraints re-checked at PR time: no open PR matches `locale` or `29895` (REST search, 0 hits).
